mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, receiver, phone, region, detail, is_default, created_at, updated_at FROM user_address WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_address (user_id, receiver, phone, region, detail, is_default) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiver}, #{phone}, #{region}, #{detail}, #{isDefault})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET receiver = #{receiver}, phone = #{phone}, region = #{region}, detail = #{detail}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_address WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_address SET is_default = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
